notes.title: New Shop, Hire Entertainers and Maintenance Workers!
notes.content: [h1]Hey Builders![/h1][p][/p][p]I've got a HUGE update for you today with  bunch of fresh new content for the game!  There's a ton to get into so I'm just going to get to it![/p][p][/p][h3]Fame Points[/h3][p][b]First off[/b], I added a new system of [b]Fame Points.[/b]  Fame points are earned by combining buildings, and can be used to unlock and upgrade stuff.  For this update, two new unique buildings can be unlocked and upgraded using fame points! [/p][p]The fame points are visible now on the main game menu: [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/b9b234bd2f5f14df5087a24a8b3548ed394baa56.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Building Maintenance[/h3][p][b]Second[/b], I wanted to challenge you guys more.  I made a system where buildings get worn down, and you have to hire maintenance people fix them.  If you don't, it starts to detract from your glorious visit rate.  [/p][p]You have to build this little guy first using fame points: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/c0ec9d589b2c6995ae8fb5ddfe5c4966bc549ec4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Then you can hire a maintenance worker here: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/9f846bf6554bf3db5f6019bd960bbc4fccf6b135.png"][/img][/p][h3]Entertainers[/h3][p][b]Next, [/b]I wanted to add more fun and life to the boardwalk.  For this update, I've added a feature to hire and upgrade entertainers.  Entertainers wander the boardwalk and earn money! [/p][p]Build this building with fame points: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/7f58bccb8f2ac86498cb2a1b940fbabb744e1ba8.png"][/img][/p][p]And then hire and upgrade them here: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/f3d5e96c0dcf33562522834b271e23400b4ca0f8.png"][/img][/p][h3]Collab with [b]Kittenship Care[/b][/h3][p][b]Last but certainly not least, [/b]I've collaborated with [b]High Flying Studio[/b] on the launch of their awesome game [b]Kittenship Care[/b]!  Part of this collab adds a cool new tier 2 building: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/44827a65ac12b5bdcbab8e91bc1f0a3f187f2b7d.png"][/img][/p][p]Can you find out which buildings to combine to make it? [/p][p]And don't forget to go buy Kittenship Care on Steam!  It's on sale now for launch week! [/p][h3]Roadmap Update[/h3][p]This update puts us a good chunk of the way through our roadmap!  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/f1fd9a6e348666023130fe906dd3bdd2f6b329f3.png"][/img][/p][p]For the next update, I'm going to [b]finish out the upgrades [/b]which includes a new [b]competitor system![/b] After that, it's on to the Event and VIP systems, then finishing out buildings!!  [/p][p][/p][p][i]Release is getting close, people!  Hold on to your butts![/i] [/p][p][/p][p]-Joel [/p]

notes.title: Better Inspection Menus (Demo Version 0.4.02)
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Boardwalkers![/h2][p]Soooo I wanted a better way to customize products for BB.  In fact, I've been playing around with this idea that you can customize each shop's product for a while now.  So I finally added it. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/96f9f96cec26ee8c7ee1c9ece70a02fbea7f58f3.png"][/img][/p][p]Each shop's slider will modify the shop's product quality and thereby it's stats.  This allows players to dial in the shop depending on what you need.  Too much capacity?  Up the quality and charge more.  Too much demand?  Dial quality back and get people through quicker.  It's up to you! 

The ride and games inspection menu has been updated with a slider as well: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/aed086153592a166e5ea775f760dc3692233c5a7.png"][/img]For rides and games, you set the "thrill level" instead of the product quality.  [/p][p]You'll notice that each menu has a small image on the mid left under "Business Controls".  This image will change depending on the product quality/thrill level, just as an indicator for easy read. [/p][p]It's a step forward on the development roadmap to give you more control over your boardwalk! [/p][p]For this update, [b]it's highly recommended to start a new game[/b] as I've also encountered some issues with the old save system (which have been addressed!) [/p][h3]Full list of changes in 0.4.02:[/h3][p][b]Enhanced Inspection Menus for Businesses[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added product quality adjustment and ride thrill level adjustment on inspection menus. [/p][list][*][p]Adjusting product quality and ride thrill levels provides the player control over fine-tuning the product price, cost, visit rate, and other attributes of each individual shop.  [/p][/*][*][p]For shops and restaurants, this allows players to increase capacity to handle more visitors at the cost of revenue, or to decrease capacity when not needed and take advantage of more premium prices.  [/p][/*][*][p]For rides, this allows players to control the service time of the ride at the expense or benefit of the ride's cost.  [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Inspection menus now show "--" for product price for rides and games, indicating that rides and game do not make money for the player. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balancing Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the amount of experience required for boardwalk levels. [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted visit rate rewards throughout the game - visit rate was increasing too fast in testing. [/p][/*][*][p]Increased the cost to operate rides. [/p][/*][*][p]Increased the cost to operate restaurants. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game could not load data due to incorrect building names being saved in data. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where customers would leave the boardwalk if the initial shop they wanted to visit was not available. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a tier mismatch error would appear when trying to combine two tier 2 buildings. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some save data issues that were causing buildings to save incorrect data. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo version 0.4.01 out now!
notes.content: [h1]Hey all!  [/h1][p][/p][p]Just a small update today.  A new build of the game has been uploaded with a new feature that will hopefully make life easier.  I was noticing that a lot of players are missing messages from Erica, so I added a message history menu where you can see the last 10 messages she has said to you along with the helper icons:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/14ed99777385fec12c349549d93e3aea6887a11c.png"][/img][/p][p]This menu can be accessed by the lower left button on the main UI next to Erica's portrait: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/3e4df3da811a503b0608df5e531bb646f38570aa.png"][/img][/p][p]Clicking on it will bring up the menu, then you can either hover over the up and down arrows to scroll the menu, or use the mousewheel. [/p][p][/p][p]A full list of changes is below: [/p][p][/p][p]0.4.01[/p][p]⦁	Created a notification history menu to show previous notification messages.  The notification message history is accessible by clicking the Notification History button on the bottom left of the main UI.  The notification menu is scrollable by hovering over the up and down scroll buttons on the notification history UI, or by using the mousewheel. [/p][p]⦁	Corrected the size of the capacity icon when it's tutorial notification was being shown. [/p][p]⦁	Notification messages will now continue to show while the game is paused[/p][p]⦁	Added some additional tutorial messages[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks builders! [/p][p][/p][p]-Joel [/p]

notes.title: Version 0.4.0 Out Now!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey builders! [/h2][p][/p][p]I've just launched version 0.4.0 this morning, and with it comes some awesome new changes to the game.  All of these changes are live in the demo, and you can check them out now! 
[/p][h3]New Combine Menu[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/c1dc3542cc655ff727d0f2e9e3f693f82d932d2d.png"][/img][/p][p]I wanted more readability for the combine function, and to make it more "fun".  This adds a marquee-style light for the combine menu, and makes it a bit cleaner. [/p][p][/p][h3]More build freedom[/h3][p]From the start of a new game, you'll be able to build any of the starting 7 tier 1 buildings instead of waiting to unlock them.  I'm hoping this will keep players more engaged.  [/p][p]
Full Change Notes: [/p][p]0.4.00[/p][p]⦁	Adjusted starting money to 1500 instead of 800[/p][p]⦁	Enabled building all tier 1 shops from the start of a new game[/p][p]⦁	Fixed an issue where reward cards wouldn't move out of the way when a bonus was selected to apply to a business[/p][p]⦁	Added new reward cards: [/p][p]⦁	Ride & attraction cost reduction[/p][p]⦁	Boardwalk visit rate increase[/p][p]⦁	Fixed an issue where you could run marketing campaign without selecting a campaign option first. [/p][p]⦁	Added an animation to the marketing confirm button. [/p][p]⦁	Fixed an issue where shop upgrades purchased through the inspection menu were not being saved correctly.[/p][p]⦁	Added a new button for marketing campaigns, and removed the marketing campaign tab from the Business Information menu [/p][p]⦁	Adjusted tutorials to provide additional instruction and focus on combine and marketing campaign buttons. [/p][p]⦁	Redesigned the Combine menu to be more compact and give it more of a boardwalk theme.  Added contrast in the menu for new stats for the combined building. [/p][p]⦁	Added tool tips to the combine menu stats when they are moused over.  [/p][p]⦁	Fixed an issue where you could start a campaign at 0 visit rate increase. [/p][p]⦁	Fixed an issue where the escape button would bring up the main menu when exiting certain other menus instead of going back to the game. [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks![/p][p][/p][p]Joel [/p]

notes.title: Announcing the Development Roadmap
notes.content: [h2]Hey Builders!  [/h2][p]I hope you're having fun with the demo.  We've already got over 100 people that have tried the game!  That is huge for me that so many of you have been interested in my little idler game.  I really hope you've enjoyed it, and there will be much more to come! [/p][h3]Demo Release Response[/h3][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/9d1574a4f94bb51f8c10fee4c520d561c5d23307.png"][/img][/h3][p]It's been awesome to watch the videos and livestreams of the demo, and read the article reviews.  There have been about five YouTube videos created for the demo, and about seven streamers have picked it up and showed it off on Twitch.  In addition, I was able to find four online articles written about the demo release!  The game was featured in the OTK pre-show, and is currently being featured as part of Clemmy's Best Indie Games summer showcase.  This is a way bigger response than I saw for Attack of the Karens, so thank you to all the content creators and promoters that have chosen to feature the game. [/p][h3]Responding to Feedback[/h3][p]I wanted to address a few issues with the demo based on user feedback and what I saw from content creators.  These items will be first on my list to address immediately for the demo:  [/p][list][*][p][b]The upgrade system seems to be a little awkward for some people[/b].  They aren't sure to click on the card when it pops up, etc.  I plan to rework this into something easier to understand. [/p][/*][*][p][b]All seven tier 1 buildings will be made available from the build menu at the start of a new game[/b], instead of having to unlock everything.  This will give the player a bit more freedom and choice at the start of the game, and bit more to do during the first few minutes of the demo.  This will hopefully also help with player retention.  [/p][/*][*][p][b]The inspection menu doesn't have much to do[/b] aside from a few one-time upgrades, and I think it's showing some misleading info.  I'm going to simplify it a bit, and add a few more controls to adjust the shops.  [/p][/*][*][p][b]Combining buildings[/b] [b]deserves a front-and-center treatment in the game[/b].  It's the main way to grow your boardwalk.  You can expect some UI updates to direct player attention to the Combine tool as well as Erica providing some additional persuasion to use the it if the player hasn't done so yet.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The [b]marketing campaigns screen is a bit too hidden[/b].  Some players didn't even know it existed until about 20 minutes into playing.  This, like combining, will get a better upfront presentation to the player with some additional persuasion from Erica.  [/p][/*][/list][p]And finally... [/p][list][*][p]Yes, [b]a docked mode will be developed for the game![/b]  This will allow you to have the game at the bottom of your screen in a docked window while you multitask.  [/p][/*][/list][h3]Development Roadmap[/h3][p]I'm generally happy with how everything else about the game is being received.  With that, I wanted to layout my roadmap for the rest of the game's development leading up to release.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/f1fd9a6e348666023130fe906dd3bdd2f6b329f3.png"][/img][/p][p]As always, I'll be responding to feedback at each of the milestones above.  Next up is the "Demo Feedback" milestone and I'm excited to see what you'll think of the improvements I've listed. [/p][p]"New Upgrades" will tackle some exciting new ways to upgrade you boardwalk. [/p][p]"Event & VIP Systems" delves into two fun new systems to promote your boardwalk and earn unique rewards (including some of the rarest buildings in the game!) [/p][p]"Finish Tier 2, 3, and 4 Buildings" will cover implementing the remaining businesses to grow the boardwalk to it's full potential. [/p][p]"Balancing & QA" will handle the delicate process of making sure the game is engaging. [/p][p]And then RELEASE with localization into Simplified Chinese and Russian!  [/p][p]Happy building, and keep sending feedback my way! [/p][p]joel@studioprimitive.net[/p][p]-Joel [/p]

notes.title: Introducing the Build System!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey Boardwalk Builders! [/b][/h1] 

I'm so excited to finally be showing this game after months of development.  Thanks again for the warm response on Steam, and I hope you're looking forward to the demo as much as I am!  

Today I wanted to start introducing some of the fundamental system of the game, starting with the build system!

In most building management games, you unlock new tiers of buildings as you go and can "plop" them onto the map.  In Boardwalk Builders, things work a little differently.

[h1]Build Categories[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/c912ecf3db249d4be96c7fd5d8e110b3b1915944.gif[/img]

Boardwalk Builders has different categories of businesses you can build.  There are seven total - Art, Media, Entertainment, Food, Health, Gifts, and Fashion.  Each one has their own "tiers" of buildings.  You can only build the lowest tier of buildings, which are small stands.  You then have to "grow" those stands into higher tiers by leveling them up and combining them!  You start the game with only a couple of stand types unlocked, and can unlock more types as you earn "fame points".  

[h1]Fame Points[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/57e12b5f000a3640329d56b54fcc61a187e8f93c.gif[/img]

Each customer that visits the boardwalk has a unique route they want to take.  For now let's just say that each shopper's route is different.  Customer visits earn exp for the stand, and once the stand levels up you earn a fame point, which are blue stars.  Those fame points can then be spent to unlock new building types and combination recipes in the upgrade menu (again, we'll delve into that in a future post). 

With this system, it lets the player "grow" their boardwalk as they keep an eye on what customers want.  

Next update we'll dive into the [b]management system[/b]!  

Happy building! 

-Joel
